name: Images to PDF
blurb: Puts images on pages, one per page, in your order.
description: Combine JPG, PNG and WebP images into a single PDF in your browser. Choose page size and margins. No upload.

name: PDF Compress
blurb: Shrinks a PDF. Light tidy-up, or flatten pages to images.
description: Reduce PDF file size in your browser. Choose a lossless tidy-up or flatten pages to compressed images for scans. No upload.

name: PDF Merge
blurb: Joins PDFs into one, in the order you choose.
description: Merge PDF files into a single document in your browser. No upload, no page limit, no watermark.

name: PDF Split
blurb: Pulls pages out of a PDF by range, or one file per page.
description: Split a PDF by page ranges or into one file per page, in your browser. No upload.

name: PDF to Images
blurb: Renders each PDF page as a PNG or JPG.
description: Convert PDF pages to PNG or JPG images in your browser at the resolution you choose. No upload.

name: Image Compress
blurb: Makes images smaller. Pick quality, watch the size.
description: Compress JPG, PNG and WebP images in your browser. Adjust quality and maximum size, batch many files, download as ZIP. No upload.

name: Image Convert
blurb: PNG, JPG, WebP and AVIF, in any direction.
description: Convert images between PNG, JPG, WebP and AVIF in your browser. Batch many files. No upload.

name: Image Resize and Crop
blurb: Set a size, pick an aspect ratio, crop, save.
description: Resize and crop images in your browser: exact pixels or percent, aspect-ratio crops with adjustable position, PNG/JPG/WebP output. No upload.

name: Remove Background
blurb: Cuts the subject out of a photo. The model runs on your device.
description: Remove image backgrounds in your browser with an on-device AI model. No upload, no account, no watermark. First use downloads the model from this site once.

name: Strip EXIF
blurb: Removes location, camera and edit data from photos. Pixels untouched.
description: Remove EXIF, GPS, XMP and other hidden metadata from JPEG, PNG and WebP photos without re-encoding. Runs entirely in your browser.

name: Case Converter
blurb: UPPER, lower, Title, camelCase, snake_case and friends.
description: Convert text between upper case, lower case, title case, sentence case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case and CONSTANT_CASE.

recipe.name: Case Converter
recipe.input:
the quick brown fox
nothing exciting happens here

name: Clean List
blurb: Trim, remove blanks, dedupe and sort a list of lines.
description: Clean a list: trim whitespace, remove empty lines, remove duplicates, and sort alphabetically, numerically or by length.

name: Diff
blurb: Shows what changed between two pieces of text.
description: Compare two texts and see added and removed lines, words or characters. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

name: Markdown Preview
blurb: Renders Markdown. Copies the HTML.
description: Preview Markdown as it will render and copy the HTML. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

recipe.name: Markdown Preview
recipe.input:
# Heading

Some *emphasis*, some **weight**, and a [link](https://example.com).

- one
- two

```js
console.log('boring');
```

| a | b |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |

name: Word Count
blurb: Counts words, characters, sentences and reading time.
description: Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs and reading time. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

recipe.name: Word Count
recipe.input:
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Nothing exciting happens here.

A second paragraph, for counting purposes.

name: CSV to Excel and back
blurb: Turns CSV into an .xlsx file, or a sheet into CSV.
description: Convert CSV to Excel (.xlsx) or Excel to CSV in your browser. Pick the sheet. Nothing is uploaded.

name: CSV to JSON and back
blurb: Converts CSV to JSON, or JSON to CSV.
description: Convert CSV to JSON or JSON to CSV in your browser. Handles quoted fields, custom delimiters and header rows.

name: JSON Formatter
blurb: Formats, minifies and validates JSON, with useful errors.
description: Format, minify and validate JSON in your browser. Error messages point at the line and column.

name: JSON to TypeScript
blurb: Infers TypeScript interfaces from a JSON sample.
description: Generate TypeScript interfaces from a JSON sample. Merges array elements, marks missing keys optional, names nested types.

name: SQL IN List
blurb: Turns a column of values into an IN (...) clause.
description: Paste a column from a spreadsheet and get a SQL IN list with correct quoting. Handles numbers, strings and apostrophes.

name: Base64
blurb: Encodes and decodes Base64, UTF-8 safe.
description: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 to text. UTF-8 safe, with URL-safe option. Runs in your browser.

name: Hash
blurb: SHA-256, SHA-1, MD5 and more, of text.
description: Hash text with SHA-256, SHA-1, SHA-512 or MD5 in your browser. For files, use File Checksum.

name: JWT Decoder
blurb: Reads a JWT's header and claims. Does not verify the signature.
description: Decode a JSON Web Token to see its header and claims, with human-readable expiry. Nothing is sent anywhere.

name: Regex Tester
blurb: Tests a JavaScript regex against text. Lists matches or replaces.
description: Test JavaScript regular expressions live: see every match with index and capture groups, or run a replace.

name: URL Encode/Decode
blurb: Percent-encodes and decodes URLs and query values.
description: Encode or decode URLs and query string values with percent-encoding. Runs in your browser.

name: Filler Text
blurb: Lorem ipsum by the paragraph, sentence or word.
description: Generate lorem ipsum placeholder text by paragraphs, sentences or words. Runs in your browser.

name: Password
blurb: Random passwords from the browser's secure generator.
description: Generate strong random passwords using your browser's cryptographic random number generator. Nothing leaves your device.

name: Placeholder Image
blurb: A flat rectangle with its size written on it. SVG or PNG.
description: Generate placeholder images of any size and colour, as SVG or PNG, without requesting them from a server.

name: QR Code
blurb: Makes a QR code from text or a link. SVG or PNG.
description: Generate QR codes from text or URLs in your browser and download them as SVG or PNG. No tracking, no expiry.

name: UUID
blurb: Generates v4 or v7 UUIDs in bulk.
description: Generate random v4 or time-ordered v7 UUIDs in your browser, in bulk, with format options.

name: Color
blurb: HEX, RGB, HSL and OKLCH, with contrast ratios.
description: Convert colours between HEX, RGB, HSL and OKLCH, and check contrast against white and black (WCAG).

name: Number Base
blurb: Binary, octal, decimal, hex and any base to 36. Big numbers too.
description: Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal and any base up to 36. Handles arbitrarily large integers.

name: Time Zone
blurb: Converts a clock time from one zone to several others.
description: Convert a date and time between time zones, including daylight saving. Pick a source zone and list the zones you need.

name: Units
blurb: Length, mass, volume, speed, area, data, time and temperature.
description: Convert units of length, mass, volume, area, speed, data size, time and temperature. Write '10 km to mi' or just '10 km' to see every unit.

recipe.name: Units
recipe.input:
10 km to mi
72 f to c
5 lb to kg
1 gb to mb
100 km/h to mph
2 cups

name: Unix Timestamp
blurb: Converts epoch seconds or milliseconds to dates, and dates to epoch.
description: Convert Unix timestamps (seconds or milliseconds) to readable dates and back. Shows UTC, a time zone of your choice, and relative time.

name: Favicon Generator
blurb: One image in; favicon.ico, PNG sizes, touch icon and HTML out.
description: Generate a complete favicon set from one image in your browser: favicon.ico, 16/32/48 PNG, Apple touch icon, Android icons and the HTML tags.

name: File Checksum
blurb: SHA-256, SHA-1, SHA-512 and MD5 of any file. Compare to a known hash.
description: Compute SHA-256, SHA-1, SHA-512 and MD5 checksums of files in your browser and compare them to a published hash. The file never leaves your device.

name: OCR
blurb: Reads text out of an image. English, on your device.
description: Extract text from images (OCR) in your browser with Tesseract. English language. No upload; the engine and language data are served from this site.

name: SVG to PNG
blurb: Rasterises an SVG at the size you want.
description: Convert SVG to PNG at any size or scale in your browser, with transparent or solid background. No upload.

name: Zip and Unzip
blurb: Makes a .zip from files, or opens one and lets you save parts.
description: Create ZIP archives or open and extract them in your browser. No upload, no size limit beyond your memory.
